title: Brahma Ka Paanchwa Sir Kyun Kata?
hooks: Brahma ji ne ek jhooth bola... aur Shiva ne unka sir hi kaat diya!
Bhagwan ne jhooth bola aur sazaa mein sir kat gaya!
Ek ghamandi jhooth... aur Shiva ke Bhairava ne liya badla!
hook_why: Instant shock hook pairing the supreme creator with a lie and decapitation in conversational Hindi, driving immediate retention.
metaphor: The Severed Ego — intellect without truth rots into pride, and only decisive truth can cut it away.

cast.Bhairava: Fierce cosmic warrior aspect of Shiva, midnight-dark skin, wild untamed locks, skull garland, piercing compassionate eyes, sharp extended thumbnail on left hand, painterly Indian dramatic art, crimson and charcoal atmosphere, no text.

Brahma ji ka paanchwa sir kyun kaata gaya? Jab gyaan ahankaar ban jaaye, tab satya hi dand deta hai. 🕉️

Sroat: Shiva Purana (Shatarudra Samhita)

Aapki nazar mein sabse mushkil kya hai—apni haar manna ya sach bolna? Batayein comments mein!

claims.claim: Brahma and Vishnu argued over supremacy at the dawn of creation
Shiva manifested as an endless Jyotirlinga to test their ego
claims.basis: Shiva Purana, Vidyeshvara Samhita & Shatarudra Samhita

claims.claim: Vishnu accepted he couldn't find the base; Brahma falsely claimed victory using Ketaki flower
Bhairava emerged from Shiva's fury and severed Brahma's fifth lying head with his thumbnail
The severed head stuck to Bhairava's hand as Kapala to teach humility
claims.basis: Kurma Purana and Shiva Purana (Bhairava Charitra)
